description: The ICUSTAYS table provides information on individual ICU stays for patients within the database. It includes identifiers for the patient, hospital admission, and specific ICU stay, along with details about the source database, care units, ward IDs, admission and discharge times, and the length of stay in the ICU. This table allows for analysis of ICU utilization, patient flow, and length of stay patterns.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each patient in the dataset.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each hospital admission.

columns.name: ICUSTAY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each ICU stay.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: The database source from which the data was obtained, e.g., 'metavision' or 'carevue'.

columns.name: FIRST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The first care unit the patient was admitted to during the ICU stay (e.g., MICU, CSRU, CCU, TSICU, SICU, NICU).

columns.name: LAST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The last care unit the patient was in during the ICU stay (e.g., TSICU, NICU, CCU, MICU, SICU, CSRU).

columns.name: FIRST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the first ward the patient was admitted to.

columns.name: LAST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the last ward the patient was in.

columns.name: INTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was admitted to the ICU.

columns.name: OUTTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was discharged from the ICU.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: The length of stay in the ICU, in days.
